Jess (CS Ops): Heads-up — noticed a spike where onboarding playbook sent duplicate nudges for ~120 accounts between 08:12–08:15 UTC. Customers got 2 nudges within ~3 minutes. :grimacing:
Mohit (Eng): yikes. any obvious root? logs?
Jess (CS Ops): attaching the runner logs snippet I grabbed: ```
[2026-03-22T08:12:13Z] playbook-runner: start run account=acct_82 trigger=onboard_nudge run_id=run_553
[2026-03-22T08:12:14Z] playbook-runner: start run account=acct_82 trigger=onboard_nudge run_id=run_554
[2026-03-22T08:12:15Z] playbook-runner: completed run run_id=run_553 status=ok
[2026-03-22T08:12:17Z] playbook-runner: completed run run_id=run_554 status=ok
```
Talia (Data): that pattern (start/start/completed/completed) looks like concurrent dispatcher duplicates. We saw similar in Nov when the dedupe lock TTL was too short.
Rupert (SE): can we soft-block retries for the same account within N seconds? safer than global locks.
Mohit (Eng): quick mitigation — added a temporary safelist to the dispatcher to ignore duplicate triggers for 5m. Pushed a cfg change: `PLAYBOOK_DEDUPE_WINDOW=300`. rolling it now.
playbook-bot: deploy started for config/playbook/dispatcher@staging -> prod (deploy id: dpl_20260322_09) :rocket:
Jess (CS Ops): thanks — any chance we can get an audit list of accounts affected? need to reach out to CS owners.
Talia (Data): running a query now to grab unique accounts with >1 nudge in that window, will post CSV link in 15m.
Mohit (Eng): long-term fix options: 1) dispatcher-level per-account mutex, 2) runner idempotency keys (persist run_id per trigger key), 3) increased visibility to retry storms. leaning to (2) + metric to detect dup rate.
Rupert (SE): agree on idempotency keys. also recommend a playbook config knob `max_concurrent_per_account` default 1.
Jess (CS Ops): prioritize outreach and a rollback plan if safelist causes misses. tagging @Mohit and @Talia for follow-up. :thumbsup:
Talia (Data): posted result: https://internal.s3/redwood/cs/duplicates_3298765432.csv (preview: 123 accounts, top 10 by duplicates attached).
Mohit (Eng): confirmed deploy rolled to prod, dedupe window active. will open a GH issue for runner idempotency and wire up a dashboard metric `playbook.dup_rate`.
